research_track: IEEE ICDE 2027 EAB candidate, exploratory reproducibility gate
selection: RE1, eligible pre and post windows, minimum repetition within each of 75 dataset/service/fault cells
window: normal last 247 rows where time < inject_time; faulty first 247 rows where time >= inject_time
preprocessing: no imputation, interpolation, resampling, or case-specific tuning
metric_statistics: 19 numeric fields per metric, including ddof=0 std and faulty minus normal differences, lexicographic metric IDs
generated_schema_version: v1 (provisional canonical public compiler marker; historical parity checked afterward)
record_uid: public_ + sha256(public case name), excluded from model_input
representation_b01: Stable UTF-8 compact JSON of verbose model_input; external record_uid wrapper
representation_b02: Stable UTF-8 compact JSON with short-key metric mapping; external record_uid wrapper
build_reference_inputs: NO historical adapter or B01/B02 files
post_build_numerical_check: Independent read of historical frozen adapter only in --mode verify
private_generated_records: kept on the user's computer, not packaged in report ZIPs
limitations: This version builds from locally stored 150 files already proven byte-identical to the pinned public revision; a separate-machine clean-room download and end-to-end rerun is not yet completed.
Historical full-adapter JSONL hash parity is not asserted because UID convention and float encoding may differ.
V1-V4 token-budget packing and positive-witness results are not rerun in this gate.
The scientifically independent EAB novelty claim has not been established.
